Regressions verified: POST /api/sipp/pull returns 400 'belum diatur' with no mapping and 400 'baca-saja' for non-SELECT queries, GET /api/download/windows serves the 111MB ZIP as attachment application/zip, login + dashboard + indicators list + data-entries save + calculate still function for a percentage indicator. Desktop code statically verified: /app/desktop/main.js exposes ipcMain handlers 'sipp:test' and 'sipp:query' using mysql2/promise with SELECT-only validateSippQuery(), /app/desktop/preload.js exposes window.kintrack.sippTest/sippQuery via contextBridge, /app/desktop/package.json has mysql2@3.11.4 in dependencies. In-browser Playwright confirmed window.kintrack is undefined (graceful fallback to backend), Sumber Data 'Uji Koneksi' hit backend and status banner shows 'root@10.10.0.2:3306/sipp FAILED', Input Data page loads cleanly (pull-sipp-button conditionally rendered only after indicator+period selected — previously verified in iter2). No console/page errors. 12/12 new pytest cases pass + 4/4 relevant iter2 regressions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1080 lines — still growing; strongly recommend router modularization (auth/indicators/data/sipp/documents/dashboard/users).

GET /api/sipp/connection/full returns the plaintext password to any admin/super_admin. This is required for the desktop LAN bridge design but is a sensitive endpoint — ensure HTTPS only (already enforced by ingress) and consider adding audit-log entry on each access + rate limiting.

_conn_error_message() heuristic matches strings like '2003' anywhere in the exception message — if a MariaDB error message happens to contain '2003' unrelated to unreachable host it could mis-map. Low risk in practice; consider matching aiomysql/pymysql errno attribute explicitly.

_store_pull uses `if period.status == 'Locked' and user['role'] != SUPER_ADMIN` — correct, but there is no similar lock check inside POST /api/sipp/pull-values for non-super-admin/admin_operator roles because require_roles already limits to those two. Documented — no fix needed.

pull-values does not validate numeric ranges (accepts negative numerator/denominator, zero denominator, or extremely large numbers). Frontend calculate handles zero denominator (via compute), but consider server-side sanity checks.
